title: Sidecars of the replica daemon: the identity record that a sidecar launcher keeps fresh, and the lease that the daemon renews so that a restarted daemon can adopt a living sidecar

Record.description: <name>.json below .cache/f/sidecars: written by the launcher of the sidecar at start and every two seconds (tmp + rename): its name, process, start, the time of this write and the sha256 of the entry script it runs. A daemon adopts the sidecar when the process lives, the write is at most fifteen seconds old and the entry script still has this hash.

Lease.description: <name>.lease below .cache/f/sidecars: written by the daemon that owns the sidecar every five seconds (tmp + rename). The launcher ends itself, and its child with it, once the last write is older than ten minutes: a daemon that restarts within that time adopts the sidecar, no daemon at all ends it.
